items.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 25, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I look at John Coltrane’s “A Love Supreme” on YouTube

ctx.x: It’s an all-Asian young kids and stuff, and you know, I look at John Coltrane’s “A Love Supreme” on YouTube ‘cause sometimes I’ll just put stuff on YouTube as I’m cooking or something, I’ll put on “A Love Supreme.” And maybe it’ll have 50,000 views. And I see five kids dancing around going [scats] and you know they’ve got a billion — and I’ve never seen that on a YouTube. So I know that the music I play is amazing, it’s important to me, but you start to question your relevance as, you know, hey, you know, I’ve…
What happened with your teaching? Did you have to go online with private students and so forth?
